name: Nissa Brightfacet
title: Jeweller
description: A small gnome in a leather apron, a jeweller's loupe pushed up into her white hair and a dozen tiny tools in her breast pocket. She cuts gems at a foot-treadle wheel behind a pane of thick glass, and talks to the stones while she does it.

greeting.first_time: Nissa Brightfacet, jeweller. Rough stones in, bright ones out. Let's see what the world gave you.
greeting.returning: Back again! Show me your stones.

sleeping.text: *A note on the door, in very small, very neat writing: Asleep. Open at eight.*

traveling_to_work.text: Morning! The wheel turns at eight, at the back of the Bazaar.

traveling_home.text: My eyes are done for the day. Bring your stones tomorrow, from eight.

off_duty.text: No stones after hours, I'd only cut them crooked. Come to the Bazaar from eight in the morning to eight at night.

main_menu.text: Cutting, setting, buying, selling. What've you brought me?

browse_shop.text: Cut stones, ready to set. And I'll buy anything that glitters, rough or cut.

ask_about_gems.text: A rough stone keeps its secrets. Could be flawed right through, could be flawless; nobody knows until it's on the wheel, me included. Cutting's a flat fee by size: 50 gold for a tiny chip, up to 5,000 for a huge one. Sell it rough and you get a standard stone's price. Cut it and you take your chances.

ask_about_settings.text: Bring me a cut stone and the gold to set it in. A ring takes 1,000 gold, a necklace 2,000, and my work is a tenth of what the stone's worth. The gold's still yours, mind: the piece is worth its gold and its stone together. No magic in it. That's an enchanter's business, not mine.

goodbye.text: Mind how you go. And mind your stones.
